game.name: Dead Space 3 (USA)(En,Fr,Es)(Disc 1)
game.desc: Dead Space 3 is a space survival-horror on Xbox 360. Supported by Sergeant John Carver, playable by a second person in cooperative mode, Isaac Clarke returns to duty after the crash of his ship on Tau Volantis, an ice planet. In search of Ellie, the adventure features new Necromorphs and, for the first time, humans in a borderline horror adventure.
